text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and low specific gravity are noted. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation for UTI, consider further evaluation for hematuria, and assess hydration status.
